en.UPGRADING: The older majors: 2.x to 3.x and 3.x to 4.0.
en.accept-shards: The flag that bought 10.6% by giving fewer cores the listener.
en.alloc: The opt-in allocator: ~10% smaller RSS, priced honestly.
en.async: Pipelining, and why the engine has no async runtime.
en.availability: Failover, epochs, and the writes we will not promise to keep.
en.boundaries: What kevy refuses, why, and what to use instead — read before you build on a guess.
en.cdc: A change feed you can tail from another process.
en.cluster: Why there is no cluster, and what to do instead.
en.cookbook: Recipes that run: sessions, rate limits, queues, leaderboards, feeds.
en.designing-on-kevy: How to think in keys when you are used to thinking in tables.
en.embedded-listener: Embed the engine and still speak RESP on a socket.
en.error-replies: Every error string, and the contract it is part of.
en.indexes: Secondary indexes: how they build, and what they cost.
en.iot: no_std, no allocator, no operating system.
en.lua: EVAL, on an interpreter we wrote.
en.migration: Moving in from Redis, and back out again.
en.persistence: The append-only log, snapshots, and what survives a kill -9.
en.pubsub: Channels, patterns, and what happens to a slow subscriber.
en.rds-workloads: What a relational workload costs here, honestly.
en.replication: One primary, N replicas, and the offset that tells you the truth.
en.table-migration: Eight production-paid lessons from replacing hand-maintained indexes.
en.tables: Declare typed columns and indexes once; query them like a table, at kevy speed.
en.text-search: BM25 full-text, and where it stops.
en.tiering: A RAM budget for a store bigger than RAM — cold values spill to disk, every command unchanged.
en.tuning: Shards, connections, and the two flags that actually matter.
en.uds: Unix sockets: no TCP, no loopback, no kernel copy.
en.upgrading-4-to-5: Stop 4.1.1, start 5.0 on the same directory — and what behaves differently.
en.upgrading-5.0-to-5.1: Stop 5.0, start 5.1 on the same directory — a read hazard repaired and two stalls removed.
en.vector-search: KNN over your keyspace. No embedding model included.
en.views: Materialised views, kept fresh by the write path.
en.wasm: 151 KB in a browser tab, persisted to OPFS.
en.upgrading-5.1-to-5.2: Stop 5.1, start 5.2 on the same directory — the Lua dialects now match upstream.

zh.UPGRADING: 更早的大版本：2.x 到 3.x，以及 3.x 到 4.0。
zh.accept-shards: 一个开关，把 listener 交给更少的核，换来 10.6%。
zh.alloc: 可选分配器：RSS 省约 10%，代价照实标价。
zh.async: pipelining，以及这个引擎为什么没有 async runtime。
zh.availability: failover、epoch，以及我们不承诺保住的那些写。
zh.boundaries: kevy 拒绝什么、为什么、改用什么——在你据此动工之前先读。
zh.cdc: 一条变更流，别的进程可以 tail 它。
zh.cluster: 为什么没有 cluster，以及该怎么办。
zh.cookbook: 能直接跑的配方：会话、限流、队列、排行榜、信息流。
zh.designing-on-kevy: 习惯了想表，现在要学着想键。
zh.embedded-listener: 嵌进去，同时还能在 socket 上讲 RESP。
zh.error-replies: 每一条错误字符串，以及它属于哪份契约。
zh.indexes: 二级索引：怎么建起来的，代价是多少。
zh.iot: no_std、没有分配器、没有操作系统。
zh.lua: EVAL —— 跑在我们自己写的解释器上。
zh.migration: 从 Redis 搬进来，以及再搬出去。
zh.persistence: append-only 日志、快照，以及 kill -9 之后还剩下什么。
zh.pubsub: 频道、模式，以及订阅者跟不上时会发生什么。
zh.rds-workloads: 关系型负载在这里到底要付多少钱 —— 照实说。
zh.replication: 一主 N 从，还有那个不会骗人的 offset。
zh.table-migration: 从手工索引迁过来的八课——每一课都在生产上付过学费。
zh.tables: 类型化列和索引声明一次，然后像查表一样查——kevy 的速度。
zh.text-search: BM25 全文检索，以及它到哪儿为止。
zh.tiering: 给 store 一个 RAM 预算，数据大过 RAM——冷值下沉到磁盘，每条命令不变。
zh.tuning: shard、连接数，以及真正有用的那两个开关。
zh.uds: Unix socket：没有 TCP、没有回环、没有内核拷贝。
zh.upgrading-4-to-5: 停 4.1.1、同目录启 5.0——以及哪些行为变了。
zh.upgrading-5.0-to-5.1: 停 5.0、同目录启 5.1——修掉一个读取隐患，去掉两处停顿。
zh.vector-search: 在你的键空间上做 KNN。不含 embedding 模型。
zh.views: 物化视图，由写路径顺手保持新鲜。
zh.wasm: 浏览器标签页里的 151 KB，持久化到 OPFS。
zh.upgrading-5.1-to-5.2: 停 5.1、在同一目录起 5.2 —— Lua 方言与上游对齐。
